Class Product2Selector

public inherited sharing class Product2Selector

Selector class for the Product2 object. Provides centralized SOQL query methods for retrieving products by Id, Stripe Id, or vendor. Returns results wrapped in a Result inner class extending Tools.QueryResult.

Group:
    Selector Classes

Since:
    08/18/2025

Version:
    1.3


Change Log

  • 08/18/2025 - v1.0 - Initial version.
  • 03/16/2026 - v1.1 - Added searchProducts() method for searching active products by name, added getProductById() method for retrieving a single product by Id, and getProductsById() to return only Id and Name fields for many.
  • 03/23/2026 - v1.2 - Method searchProducts() removed. Field Price__c added to getProductById().
  • 03/24/2026 - v1.3 - Added getVendorProduct() method.
